items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'A friend of Barbara’s' in the context of a reviewer, but the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not confirm any personal relationship with Barbara Bel Geddes.

ctx.x: Tell me about that, your reception there and how . . .? Did they know about you in New York? Because of the recordings, they must have.
I guess the word had gotten – we’d had a good review from John Hammond, a really good review. Then two other reviewers – the one married to the actress. A friend of Barbara’s . . .

The trio had had some good reviews, and the quartet was newer on the scene, but in some of the magazines at that time, there were good reviews of the trio recordings. Metronome. Oh, Barry Ulanov. Is that who you mean?
